provenance
A
In sample. The labels were made on these 32 traces and the checks were built against them. This shows the checks reproduce the labels they were built from, not that they generalise.
B
Run-specific calibration is not established. The labels in data/codes_v1.json were made on traces/v1, not on this run. The supplied labels have not been established as labels for this run; these numbers do not establish held-out agreement or generalisation.
